crossRefs.note: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not…
“ ‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall…
You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent…
You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all…
For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”
Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury…
he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from…
who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has…
In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your…
“Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
“You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…
and said, “What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you?” They weighed out for him thirty pieces…
Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of…
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and…
Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father…
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will…
For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

translations.web: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
translations.bsb: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
translations.kjv: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
translations.asv: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved. Psalm 16 Michtam of David.
